description: Combines the XP feedback for the same player, source and skill into one message sent when the scheduled callback runs; amounts of zero or less are ignored. Each combination schedules one callback, and an add after the callback has run starts a new message.
inputs: Scripted add calls (player/source/skill/xp), each script followed by running the scheduled callbacks in order. A | in the script runs the callbacks scheduled so far before the next add.
